افتحلن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلْنَ (iftaḥalna) /if.ta.ħal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اُفْتُحِلْنَ (uftuḥilna) /uf.tu.ħil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحِلْنَ (iftaḥilna) /if.ta.ħil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
